extraction.name: MVBench
extraction.description: A comprehensive Multi-modal Video understanding benchmark which covers 20 challenging video tasks that cannot be effectively solved with a single frame.
extraction.creator: Kunchang Li, Yali Wang, Yinan He, Yizhuo Li, Yi Wang, Yi Liu, Zun Wang, Jilan Xu, Guo Chen, Ping Luo, Limin Wang, Yu Qiao
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Videos are selected from existing public benchmarks and their annotations are automatically converted into multiple-choice QAs using LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Public video datasets including STAR, PAXION, Moments in Time V1, FunQA, CLEVRER, Perception Test, Charades-STA, MoVQA, NTU RGB+D, VLN-CE, and TVQA.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Short clips with negligible motions and extremely long videos with overly complicated contexts were eliminated, selecting videos with intermediate duration primarily ranging from 5s to 35s.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Video annotations were automatically converted into a multiple-choice QA format using ChatGPT to generate questions based on task definitions, and answer options were constructed either directly from ground truth annotations or generated by LLMs.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Evaluating the temporal perception capabilities of Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs).
